town.text: I can run that for you! Two coppers. One if you're nice. Three if you're not.
I didn't take it. I was holding it. For you. Here.
Bree says I'm not to bother you. I'm not bothering. I'm standing.
I know a quicker way round the docks. Don't ask how. I just do.

camp.text: There's a song in my head again. I never learned it. Want to hear?
The stars are wrong tonight. No. They're right. I just remember them different.
Can I sit with you? Just till I'm sleepy. I'm not scared. I'm cold.
I dreamed of a big stone hall with a fire in the middle. I've never been in a hall.
camp.direction: slow, far away, then herself again

camp.text: Tell me a story. A true one. I'll know if it isn't.
